# Jose Diaz Tutoring

> Math, physics and engineering tutoring for high school and university students, taught by Jose Diaz, an engineer with more than 15 years designing electronics and firmware for medical devices and aerospace systems. One-on-one and small-group sessions, online from anywhere or in person in Broward and Miami-Dade counties (South Florida), in English or Spanish. The first 20-minute intro call is free.

## Subjects

High school (grades 9–12, including honors, AP and dual enrollment):

- Algebra 1 & 2, including Florida EOC prep
- Geometry, including Florida EOC prep
- Precalculus & trigonometry
- AP Calculus AB & BC
- Physics & AP Physics 1, 2, C
- SAT & ACT math

University (math and physics for STEM, pre-med and engineering majors):

- College algebra & precalculus
- Calculus I, II & III
- Differential equations
- Physics I & II, algebra- or calculus-based
- Midterm & final exam reviews, one-on-one or in groups

Engineering courses (for electrical and computer engineering students):

- Electric circuits I & II (DC, AC, transients)
- Digital logic design
- Programming (C, C++, Python)
- Microcontrollers & embedded systems

Tutoring for courses at FIU, FAU, Miami Dade College, Broward College, University of Miami and Nova Southeastern, plus high schools across Broward and Miami-Dade, and online students anywhere.

## Levels

- High school
- University
- University engineering courses

## Rates

Sessions are 60 minutes, online or in person. The intro call is always free. In-person sessions in Broward and Miami-Dade are the same price.

- High school, one-on-one: $65 per hour
- University, one-on-one: $90 per hour
- Engineering courses, one-on-one: $110 per hour
- Group exam review: $40 per student, per hour (3–5 students from the same course, 2-hour session before a midterm or final)
- High school, monthly plan: $480 for 8 sessions a month, same day and time each week ($60/hour)
- University, semester package: $970 for 12 one-on-one sessions scheduled around midterms and the final (about $81/hour)

Packages are paid at the start and valid for the current semester. Reschedule for free with at least 24 hours' notice; sessions cancelled with less notice are charged in full.

## Service area

- In person: Broward County and Miami-Dade County, Florida (at the student's home, a library or campus)
- Online: anywhere

## Languages

English and Spanish. Many students switch between both.

## Credentials

- Engineering degree from CUJAE (Universidad Tecnológica de La Habana José Antonio Echeverría, the Technological University of Havana); graduated 5th of 150
- 15+ years as an engineer in industry (electronics and firmware for medical devices and aerospace systems)
- Tutoring in the U.S. since 2016, from middle school through university
